# Sam Moran

> Official profile of Sam Moran, an Australian academic researcher, creative practitioner and speaker examining artificial intelligence, entertainment and the future of human creativity.

Canonical URL: https://www.sammoran.phd/
Language: en-AU
Location: Sydney, Australia
Affiliation: Macquarie University
Contact: hello@childsplay.media

## Profile

Sam Moran studies how artificial intelligence is reshaping entertainment and how artists, studios and audiences can use emerging technology to expand human creativity. His perspective combines academic research with first-hand experience in music, television, live entertainment and creative production.

## Primary areas of expertise

- Artificial intelligence in entertainment
- Human–AI collaboration
- Creative agency after automation
- Creative labour and the future of entertainment work
- Responsible AI adoption without fear or hype
- Creative industries, production cultures and audience trust

## Speaking, advisory and media

Sam is available for keynotes, panels, workshops, research collaboration, organisational advisory work, interviews and broadcast commentary. Enquiries should be sent to hello@childsplay.media.
